recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No FHIR core source fix is needed for FHIR-31797 unless BRR makes a new decision to rename or remodel the element.
issue_request: FHIR-31797 was a Published/Persuasive with Modification R5 request to clarify PackagedProductDefinition.containedItemQuantity because repeated quantities without item-type context were ambiguous; the final resolution requested usage-note text and different units for multiple repetitions.
initial_application: The accepted guidance was applied before this reconciliation in commits a244714665 and 3c738e3beb, then refined and synced by 091c15f2de and c582702619. The current source preserves the complete-count wording, 21+7 tablet aggregation example, repeat-by-item-type rule, disjoint-units requirement, and warning against using repeats for alternative pack sizes.
additional_context: PackagedProductDefinition is in current build scope through active source/fhir.ini entries. FHIR-31798 later shortened short definitions without removing the long FHIR-31797 guidance, and FHIR-39128 later kept the containedItemQuantity name while adding see-also text between containedItemQuantity and packaging.containedItem.amount. BRR minutes from 2021-10-28 confirm the same wording trail, and no conflicting community evidence was found.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit because the current authoritative StructureDefinition already implements the issue's accepted semantic clarification.
